frame: All 13 existing catalogue entries with 2022-03-19 <= catalogue_date < 2022-04-18; no outside-frame additions.

status_meanings.METADATA_READY_FOR_HISTORICAL_GATES: Identity, occurrence, reported execution date and chain metadata support the next eligibility checks. This is not scientific admission, complete historical coverage or a verified UTC boundary.
status_meanings.NOT_REALIZED_INCIDENT: This specific entry is a disclosed or prevented vulnerability record. It is not a positive attack example or a negative-labelled monitoring example; global absence of unreported attacks is not claimed.
status_meanings.METADATA_UNRESOLVED_UNDER_CAP: Required metadata remains unestablished or conflicted in the bounded screen. Preserve the entry in the denominator.
status_meanings.DEVELOPMENT_EXCLUDED: Prior development exclusion retained; no new independent-cohort admission.

chain_evidence_note: Ethereum/BSC attribution inferred from an official incident-specific explorer link is labelled primary_incident_locator_inference. It is not a fetched receipt or independent chain verification. Empty chain lists mean unresolved or not re-adjudicated, not no chain.
date_evidence_note: Catalogue dates, report dates and execution dates are distinct. Every reported date keeps its evidence precision; null is unknown or inapplicable, not absence of an incident.
family_rule: Use the earliest supported enabling violation, keeping financing and later effects separate. Disclosed-vulnerability mechanisms do not count toward realized-incident family diversity.
claim_limits: No scientific incident was admitted and no detector score was computed in this metadata screen.
Historical deployment, population, routing, continuous data and positive-label gates remain separate.
The catalogue is label-informed and resource-conditioned; no representative sampling or global blindness is claimed.
The scientific methods were not changed using these metadata findings.
